title: Organizing Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.05417v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When will advances in AI lead to economic transformation? We develop a model of how intelligence, the ability to achieve goals, matters for organizations, the key unit of economic production. Agents (human or AI) with multidimensional capabilities sort endogenously into competing firms. A firm's productivity depends on its agents' capabilities; we distinguish competence, which shifts productivity levels, from coordination, which governs how productivity scales with size. Two differences between AI and humans drive transformation: AI expertise is reproducible while humans' are in fixed supply, and AIs may not face the same human limits on coordination. We analyze how equilibrium market structure, productivity, employment, and wages evolve as AI capabilities improve. translated_abstract: 人工智能的进步何时会带来经济变革？我们建立了一个模型，研究智能（即实现目标的能力）如何对组织——经济生产的关键单位——产生影响。具有多维能力的智能体（人类或AI）会内生地分配到相互竞争的企业中。企业的生产力取决于其智能体的能力；我们区分了“胜任力”与“协调力”，前者改变生产力的水平，后者决定生产力如何随规模扩张而增长。AI与人类之间的两个差异推动了变革：AI的专业知识是可复制的，而人类的专业知识供给是固定的；此外，AI可能不受人类在协调方面所面临的固有限制。我们分析了随着AI能力的提升，均衡状态下的市场结构、生产力、就业和工资如何演变。当AI的能力超过普通人类时，由具有互补性的个体组成的组织仍可能胜过AI。AI胜任力的提升可以改变工……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了一个智能如何影响经济组织的模型，指出AI专业知识可复制与协调能力可能突破人类极限这两大差异是驱动经济变革的关键，并证明即使AI能力超过普通人，互补型人类组织仍可能胜过AI。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a model of how intelligence matters for organizations as the key unit of economic production, showing that AI's reproducible expertise and potentially unrestricted coordination drive economic transformation, while organizations of complementary humans can still outperform AI even when it is more capable than the average human.
